messages.subject: GCC Executive Profile | Government Relations, ESG & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Ali,

Your executive-search leadership across Saudi Arabia, the UAE, public-sector and PIF-related organisations makes this a strong fit for my profile. I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with responsibilities across government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. Saudi Arabia is my first-priority market, and I am targeting Director, VP, Country and Regional appointments where institutional relationships, responsible development and strategic execution are central to enterprise performance.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
